backlog.title: Alembic migration: create outbox table
backlog.description: Autogenerate and hand-review a migration creating the outbox table (event_id FK, status, locked_at, attempts, created_at) written in the same transaction as the owning event, per the plan's data model.

backlog.title: Alembic migration: create deliveries table
backlog.description: Autogenerate and hand-review a migration creating the deliveries table (event_id FK, endpoint_id FK, state, attempt_count, next_retry_at, created_at), one row per (event, subscribed endpoint) pair.

backlog.title: Alembic migration: create delivery_attempts table
backlog.description: Autogenerate and hand-review a migration creating the delivery_attempts table (delivery_id FK, attempt_no, response_status, latency_ms, error_class, request/response snippets, created_at) as a plain append-only table, deliberately unpartitioned per the plan's scope discipline.

backlog.title: Define Phase 2 domain entities
backlog.description: Define pure domain entities for OutboxEntry, Delivery, and DeliveryAttempt as dataclasses/value objects with zero I/O, expressing delivery state transitions (pending -> in-flight -> delivered/retrying/dead) independent of persistence or transport.

backlog.title: Define Phase 2 ORM models
backlog.description: Define SQLAlchemy 2.0 mapped classes for Outbox, Delivery, and DeliveryAttempt matching the Phase 2 migrations, kept in the repositories layer and never imported by the domain or api layers.

backlog.title: Implement backoff-with-jitter calculator
backlog.description: Implement a pure domain function computing `min(cap, base * 2^attempt)` with full jitter for retry scheduling, unit-tested for monotonic cap behavior and jitter bounds, with the rationale for full jitter (avoiding synchronized retry storms) captured in a docstring-adjacent comment or the eventual ADR.

backlog.title: Write the outbox row in the event's own transaction
backlog.description: Extend EventIngestService's unit-of-work so the outbox row is inserted in the exact same transaction as the event row, so a `202` response is only ever returned after both are durably committed together.

backlog.title: Implement OutboxRepository with SKIP LOCKED claiming
backlog.description: Implement OutboxRepository with a claim-due-rows operation using `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, plus mark-processed/mark-failed operations, so concurrent relay instances never claim the same row.

backlog.title: Implement DeliveryRepository
backlog.description: Implement DeliveryRepository with create (one row per subscribed endpoint), get, and update operations (state, attempt_count, next_retry_at) returning domain entities, never ORM objects.

backlog.title: Implement DeliveryAttemptRepository
backlog.description: Implement DeliveryAttemptRepository exposing an append-only insert for attempt rows (response_status, latency_ms, error_class, request/response snippets), with no update or delete operation since the log is immutable.

backlog.title: Implement Redis Streams infra wiring
backlog.description: Extend the infra layer with stream-naming conventions, idempotent consumer-group creation (`XGROUP CREATE ... MKSTREAM`, tolerating `BUSYGROUP`), and thin `XADD`/`XREADGROUP`/`XACK` helpers used by the relay and dispatcher workers.

backlog.title: Implement Redis ZSET retry-schedule infra wiring
backlog.description: Extend the infra layer with helpers to add a delivery to the retry ZSET scored by `next_retry_at` and to pop all entries whose score is now due, used by the retry path and the scheduler tick.

backlog.title: Implement outbound HTTP sender port and httpx adapter
backlog.description: Define an outbound-HTTP-sender port (protocol) plus a real httpx-based adapter with explicit connect/read timeouts, and a fake adapter for tests, so DeliveryAttemptService never imports httpx directly.

backlog.title: Implement DeliveryAttemptService
backlog.description: Implement a service that sends one delivery attempt via the HTTP sender port, classifies the outcome (2xx success / retryable failure / timeout), and writes the attempt row via DeliveryAttemptRepository, returning enough for the caller to decide the next state transition.

backlog.title: Implement the relay worker: claim, fan out, publish
backlog.description: Implement the relay worker loop: claim due outbox rows via OutboxRepository, resolve each event's subscribed endpoints, create one Delivery row and `XADD` one stream message per endpoint, and mark the outbox row processed — all within a single unit of work so a crash mid-fan-out is safely retried, not partially applied.

backlog.title: Implement the dispatcher worker's consumer loop
backlog.description: Implement the dispatcher worker: an `XREADGROUP` consumer-group loop that pulls delivery stream messages and invokes DeliveryAttemptService for each, acking only after the attempt is durably recorded.

backlog.title: Implement bounded async worker pool inside the dispatcher
backlog.description: Bound the dispatcher's concurrency with an async worker pool (fixed task count reading from the same consumer group), so message intake exerts backpressure rather than spawning unbounded concurrent deliveries.

backlog.title: Implement the retry-on-failure path
backlog.description: On a retryable failure or timeout, compute `next_retry_at` via the backoff-with-jitter calculator, update the Delivery row's state and attempt_count, and push the delivery into the Redis retry ZSET instead of re-queuing immediately.

backlog.title: Implement the scheduler worker
backlog.description: Implement the scheduler worker: a tick loop that pops due entries from the retry ZSET and `XADD`s each back onto the delivery stream, so retries flow through the same consumer-group path as fresh deliveries.

backlog.title: Implement the XAUTOCLAIM reaper worker
backlog.description: Implement the reaper worker: periodically `XAUTOCLAIM`s pending entries idle past the visibility timeout (consumer died mid-delivery) and re-dispatches them, which is what makes the at-least-once guarantee real rather than aspirational.

backlog.title: Implement graceful SIGTERM drain for all workers
backlog.description: Add SIGTERM handling to the relay, dispatcher, scheduler, and reaper workers: stop pulling new work, finish in-flight deliveries, then exit — so a deploy swap never truncates a delivery mid-flight.

backlog.title: Add worker entrypoints and wire them into docker-compose
backlog.description: Add `python -m relay.workers.{relay,dispatcher,scheduler,reaper}` entrypoints and corresponding services in `docker-compose.yml` so `make up` brings up the full delivery pipeline locally alongside the api, postgres, and redis containers already there.

backlog.title: Extend import-linter contract for the workers module
backlog.description: Extend the import-linter contract to place `relay.workers` correctly in the `api -> services -> repositories -> infra` layering (workers depend on services/repositories/infra, nothing depends on workers), and verify a deliberately forbidden import fails the contract.

backlog.title: Add testcontainers Redis Streams fixture for the integration suite
backlog.description: Extend the existing testcontainers Redis fixture with consumer-group setup/teardown (`XGROUP CREATE`/`XGROUP DESTROY`) scoped per test, so integration tests exercise real `XREADGROUP`/`XACK`/`XAUTOCLAIM` semantics rather than a mocked stream.

backlog.title: Add polyfactory factories for Phase 2 entities
backlog.description: Add polyfactory factories for OutboxEntry, Delivery, and DeliveryAttempt domain entities so integration tests can generate realistic delivery-pipeline data without hand-rolled fixtures.

backlog.title: Integration test: crash before relay publish is recovered
backlog.description: Add an integration test proving that if the process dies after the DB commit but before the relay publishes to the stream, the outbox row survives and a subsequent relay run picks it up — Testing scenario #1.

backlog.title: Integration test: SKIP LOCKED gives a row to exactly one relay
backlog.description: Add an integration test running two relay claim operations concurrently against the same due outbox row and asserting `SKIP LOCKED` gives it to exactly one, with the other getting nothing — Testing scenario #2.

backlog.title: Chaos test: XAUTOCLAIM reclaims a message after a worker dies
backlog.description: Add a chaos test that kills a dispatcher worker after `XREADGROUP` but before it acks, then asserts the reaper's `XAUTOCLAIM` reclaims the pending message and it is redelivered — Testing scenario #3.

backlog.title: Idempotency test: redelivery after a post-send crash produces a duplicate
backlog.description: Add a test that kills a worker after the HTTP request is sent but before it acks, and asserts the receiver observes a duplicate delivery on redelivery — the test that proves exactly-once external effects are impossible by design, per Testing scenario #4.

backlog.title: Integration test: a 500 response schedules jittered backoff
backlog.description: Add an integration test (using `respx` and `freezegun`) proving a downstream 500 response schedules a retry with a `next_retry_at` matching the backoff formula within its jitter bounds — Testing scenario #7.

backlog.title: Integration test: a timeout is recorded as a timeout, not a success
backlog.description: Add an integration test proving a downstream connection that times out mid-response is recorded with `error_class=timeout` and never marked as a successful delivery — Testing scenario #8.

backlog.title: Integration test: a due retry moves from the ZSET back onto the stream
backlog.description: Add an integration test proving that once a ZSET entry's `next_retry_at` is due, the scheduler tick pops it and `XADD`s it back onto the delivery stream exactly once — Testing scenario #9.

backlog.title: Write ADR: Phase 2 delivery engine decisions
backlog.description: Write docs/adr/0004-phase-2-delivery-engine.md capturing the Phase 2 decisions (transactional outbox vs. publishing straight to Redis, Redis Streams consumer groups vs. Celery, full-jitter exponential backoff, at-least-once vs. attempted exactly-once) with alternatives considered and the tradeoff accepted for each.

backlog.title: Update docs/failure-modes.md with Phase 2 rows
backlog.description: Add Phase 2 rows to docs/failure-modes.md (outbox survives a pre-publish crash, SKIP LOCKED race, XAUTOCLAIM reclaim, duplicate delivery after a post-send crash, jittered backoff on failure, timeout classification, ZSET-to-stream retry handoff), each naming the expected behavior and the test that proves it.
